name: Royal Bridal
style: The bridal design from reference/reference.webp (forearm bands, lattice, palm mandala, dipped fingertips).

name: Full Bridal
style: Very dense full bridal mehndi covering both forearms up to the top of the photo. The forearms have stacked horizontal bands: architectural arches and domes, fine lattice nets, leafy bands, floral bands and small peacock motifs. The palms are covered with a large fine diamond mesh lattice framed by florals and a central mandala. Every finger has detailed bands and all fingertips are fully dipped in solid henna caps. Extremely intricate, professional bridal work.

name: Bold Arabic
style: Bold modern Arabic mehndi. A bold diagonal composition running from the wrist across the palm up to the index finger, made of large fern-like leaves in thick filled dark maroon-black strokes, with shaded half-mandalas whose insides have fine detailed linework, plus leafy vines running up each finger. All five fingertips fully dipped in solid dark henna caps. Forearms mostly bare except a small leafy trail above the wrist.

name: Peacock Trail
style: Elegant Indo-Arabic trail mehndi. One large flower near the wrist with a dot-filled centre and shaded petals, with dangling chains of dots hanging from it like tassels, and sweeping swirls, curls and peacock-feather paisleys flowing diagonally up toward the index finger. The fingers have half-cap designs of curved feather strokes near the tips and small motifs. Fine, crisp, intricate linework. Forearms bare apart from the tassels.

name: Rose Lattice
style: Floral palm mehndi. Several large open roses with outlined petals and lightly shaded insides arranged in the palm around a central paisley medallion whose inside is a small checkered grid, small leaf sprigs between flowers, and a decorated band at the wrist. Each finger has stacked bands of fine lattice / checkered net with small leaf tops, ending below the fingertip so the fingertips stay mostly bare. Forearms bare.

name: Minimal Mandala
style: Minimal elegant mehndi. A single round mandala flower in the centre of each palm with fine petals and a ring of dots, a delicate dotted chain from the mandala to the middle finger, small dots at the base of each finger, and only the very tips of the fingers lightly dipped. A thin delicate bracelet line with tiny hanging dots at each wrist. Lots of bare skin, clean and modern.
